description: Install, query, run samples for, unload, remove, or index Gretl function/data packages using the native pkg command. By default this also requires opening the generated workflow in the visible Gretl GUI.

displayInGretl.description: Open the generated package command script in Gretl GUI. Defaults to true outside CI.

local.description: Use pkg --local for a local .gfn or .zip package file.

packageName.description: Package name, local package path, URL, or addons for index. Required except index defaults to addons.

requireGui.description: Require the visible Gretl GUI to open for this workflow. Defaults to true outside CI.

staging.description: Use pkg --staging for package installs from Gretl staging.

name: gretl_package
